measures.name: KPI Sales Avg
measures.dax:
VAR _cur = [CY Sales]
VAR _avg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(Orders[Order Date]), [CY Sales]), ALLSELECTED(Orders[Order Date]))
RETURN IF(_cur > _avg, "Above", "Below")
measures.description: Whether current-year sales are above or below the period average.

measures.name: KPI Profit Avg
measures.dax:
VAR _cur = [CY Profit]
VAR _avg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(Orders[Order Date]), [CY Profit]), ALLSELECTED(Orders[Order Date]))
RETURN IF(_cur > _avg, "Above", "Below")
measures.description: Whether current-year profit is above or below the period average.

measures.name: Min/Max Sales
measures.dax:
VAR _cur = [CY Sales]
VAR _mx = MAXX(ALLSELECTED(Orders[Order Date]), [CY Sales])
VAR _mn = MINX(ALLSELECTED(Orders[Order Date]), [CY Sales])
RETURN IF(OR(_cur = _mx, _cur = _mn), _cur, BLANK())
measures.description: Highlights the period min/max of current-year sales.
